description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.021 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. US CPI inflation: headline (all-items), core (less food & energy), energy, and food — MoM and YoY % changes, ACCELERATING/DECELERATING/STABLE trend signal, and Fed policy implication. BLS data via FRED public CSV, no API key needed. Pairs with fomc-tracker, credit-spreads, treasury-yields, sector-rotation.
name: inflation-intel

all_items.description: CPI-U All Items, Seasonally Adjusted. Standard 'headline CPI'.

yoy_pct.description: Year-over-year % change — the headline inflation rate.

core.description: Core CPI (Less Food & Energy), SA. The Fed's primary inflation signal — strips volatile food and energy.

yoy_pct.description: Year-over-year % change — the core inflation rate the Fed targets.

energy.description: CPI Energy component, SA. High-volatility driver of headline CPI divergence from core.

fed_implication.description: Plain-English Fed policy implication derived from current core CPI level and trend.

trend_signal.description: Direction of core CPI YoY over the last 3 months: ACCELERATING (rising), DECELERATING (falling), STABLE (< 0.15pp delta), or unknown.
